title: Basketball Jersey Maker (2026)
verdict: A good basketball jersey maker gets you from a blank jersey to a finished one in a few minutes. In 2026 the one to open first is Wooter's builder: pick a basketball style, recolor it, add a logo and team name, and the jersey and its price update as you go.
Boombah has a capable maker for reversible sets. Custom Ink's Design Lab makes printed jerseys. Champro's and Nike Team's makers save a design for a dealer to order.
steps_title: Make a basketball jersey in ten minutes

steps.name: Choose a style
steps.text: Scroll the basketball styles and pick the one closest to what you have in mind.

steps.name: Change the colors
steps.text: Set the body, trim and number colors. Check the number stands out from the body at a glance.

steps.name: Add your logo and name
steps.text: Upload the logo and type the team name. Keep the chest uncluttered.

steps.name: Check the price
steps.text: It sits beside the preview and moves with quantity.

steps.name: Add the roster
steps.text: One line per player with name, number and size.

steps.name: Order
steps.text: Review the proof, approve it and place the order.

ranking.fit: Anyone who wants to make a jersey online tonight and order it for the team tomorrow.
ranking.lacks: It makes real jerseys, so there is a three to four week wait after approval.

ranking.fit: Teams that want reversible jerseys and shorts built online by a maker with its own factories.
ranking.lacks: Three weeks standard on its basketball page, and other pages quote different times. Confirm before you order.

ranking.fit: Small groups that need names and numbers on a stock jersey or reversible tank in about two weeks.
ranking.lacks: A print tool for stock jerseys, not a pattern maker.

ranking.fit: Programs with a team dealer that want cut-and-sew Juice sublimation.
ranking.lacks: The maker stops at a saved design. A dealer takes it from there.

ranking.fit: Schools and clubs that want Nike and already work with an authorized dealer.

why: Ten minutes is a fair target for a first jersey. The time goes on three choices: the style, the colors and where the logo sits.
Wooter's maker opens with 500+ professionally designed styles, so the first choice is a click. Colors change in place, and your logo and team name drop onto the jersey.
The step that takes longer is the roster. Have each player's name, number and size ready and it goes quickly.

criteria.name: Speed to a first jersey
criteria.text: Minutes, without an account wall before you see anything.

criteria.name: Logo upload
criteria.text: Your artwork on the jersey, not clip art.

faq.q: Is the basketball jersey maker free?
faq.a: Yes. Wooter's builder costs nothing to use. You pay when you order.

faq.q: Can I save a jersey and come back?
faq.a: Yes. Finish the design, then return to add the roster and order.
Wooter sells basketball uniforms as sets, so the jersey design carries onto shorts.

faq.q: Can I make one jersey for myself?
faq.a: Yes. Wooter's product pages list a minimum quantity of one.
Switch to the free design service. A designer finishes the jersey and sends a mockup in 1 to 2 business days.
